questions.stem: Which expression describes Ben carrying something to Mia?
questions.listenScript: Mia cannot leave her desk while she paints. Ben carries a clean cup of water over and places it beside her.

listenLines.text: Mia cannot leave her desk while she paints. Ben carries a clean cup of water over and places it beside her.

questions.explanation: The situation supports “bring sth. to sb. (=bring sb. sth.)”: Mia cannot leave her desk while she paints. Ben carries a clean cup of water over and places it beside her.
questions.parentExplanation: 情境证据：米娅画画时不能离开桌子。本把一杯干净的水拿过来，放在她旁边。；对应本题“给某人带来某物”这一用法。

translation.stem: 哪个表达描述本把东西带给米娅？

questions.stem: Which expression introduces the fallen tree as the reason?

listenLines.text: The school bus cannot use the road today. A fallen tree blocks it, so the driver chooses another way.

questions.explanation: The situation supports “because of”: The school bus cannot use the road today. A fallen tree blocks it, so the driver chooses another way.
questions.parentExplanation: 情境证据：校车今天不能走这条路。一棵倒下的树挡住了路，所以司机改走另一条路线。；对应本题“因为”这一用法。

questions.stem:
When the alarm sounds, leave the building at once instead of stopping to collect your bag.
What does “at once” mean here?

translation.stem: 警报响起时，请立刻离开楼房，不要停下收拾书包。 这里“at once”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “at once” means “immediately, without delay”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“at once”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“immediately, without delay”。对应源表释义为“立刻，马上”。

questions.stem:
We try many ways to open the stuck lid. At last, it moves and the jar opens.
What does “At last” mean here?

translation.stem: 我们尝试许多办法打开卡住的盖子。终于，它动了，罐子打开了。 这里“At last”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “at last” means “finally, after waiting or difficulty”.

questions.stem: For the class play, the children d________ as forest animals.

questions.stem: This apple is too large to eat whole. Please c________ into small pieces.
questions.hint: Use it for the apple; place the pronoun in the middle of the phrase.
questions.explanation: With the pronoun it, the correct order is cut it up.
questions.parentExplanation: 代词it必须放在cut和up之间，不能写cut up it。

questions.stem: I d________ a little house near the sea where my family can live.
questions.hint: Use the two-word phrase with of meaning wish strongly for a future possibility; agree the verb with the subject.
questions.explanation: The house is a desired future possibility, so the speaker dreams of it.
questions.parentExplanation: 梦想某物用dream of；of后接名词短语。

translation.stem: 我梦想拥有一栋海边小屋，让家人可以住在那里。

questions.stem: Mia d________ six equal pieces so that everyone gets the same amount.
questions.hint: Use the phrase meaning splits the cake into portions; agree with Mia.
questions.grammar: divides + the cake + into + 部分
questions.explanation: Mia is singular and the cake is the object, giving divides the cake into.
questions.parentExplanation: Mia配divides，the cake是被分对象，into后接六份。

translation.stem: 米娅把蛋糕分成六等份，让每个人得到同样多。

questions.stem: We study in the s________ school and meet at its gate every morning.
questions.hint: The adjective shows that there is one school shared by both of us.
questions.explanation: One school shared by the two speakers is the same school.
questions.parentExplanation: 两人在同一所学校，填same；the已经在题干中。

translation.stem: 我们在同一所学校上学，每天早上在它的门口见面。

questions.hint: Use the three-word phrase for having plenty of strength and liveliness.
questions.explanation: Their continuing lively activity shows that they are full of energy.
questions.parentExplanation: 持续活跃而不累，说明full of energy；of后energy不可数。

translation.stem: 孩子们充满活力；他们不断跑、玩、笑，一点也不累。

questions.stem: After primary school, I start j________ before moving on to senior high school.
questions.hint: Use the three-word name of the school stage between primary and senior high.
questions.explanation: The school stage between primary and senior high is junior high school.
questions.parentExplanation: 小学与高中之间的学段为junior high school。

translation.stem: 小学毕业后，我先读初中，再升入高中。

questions.stem: Why does the club use both sides of practice sheets?
questions.explanation: The answer is “To avoid using and buying unnecessary paper.”. Evidence: Meanwhile, the price of paper may go up next month. Our teacher shows us a note from the shop about the possible increase. We count the cards we need and use both sides of our practice sheets. By planning carefully, we can protect the machine and avoid buying unnecessary paper.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“To avoid using and buying unnecessary paper.”。原文依据：与此同时，纸张价格下个月可能会上涨。老师给我们看了商店发来的关于可能涨价的通知。我们数好所需卡片，并把练习纸两面都利用起来。认真计划后，我们既能保护机器，也能避免买不必要的纸。

questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Careful planning helps an art club use its resources wisely.”. Evidence: Our art club wants to print cards for the school fair. The printer may go wrong if we ignore the warning light. We stop and ask the teacher to check it before printing. Meanwhile, the price of paper may go up next month. Our teacher shows us a note from the shop about the possible increase. We count the cards we need and use both sides of our practice sheets. By planning carefully, we can protect the machine and avoid buying unnecessary paper.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Careful planning helps an art club use its resources wisely.”。原文依据：我们美术社想为学校展会印一些卡片。如果我们不理会警示灯，打印机可能会出毛病。我们停下来，在打印前请老师检查。与此同时，纸张价格下个月可能会上涨。老师给我们看了商店发来的关于可能涨价的通知。我们数好所需卡片，并把练习纸两面都利用起来。认真计划后，我们既能保护机器，也能避免买不必要的纸。

passages.text: Our art club wants to print cards for the school fair. The printer may go wrong if we ignore the warning light. We stop and ask the teacher to check it before printing. Meanwhile, the price of paper may go up next month. Our teacher shows us a note from the shop about the possible increase. We count the cards we need and use both sides of our practice sheets. By planning carefully, we can protect the machine and avoid buying unnecessary paper.

parallelText.en: Our art club wants to print cards for the school fair.
parallelText.zh: 我们美术社想为学校展会印一些卡片。

parallelText.en: The printer may go wrong if we ignore the warning light.
parallelText.zh: 如果我们不理会警示灯，打印机可能会出毛病。

parallelText.en: We stop and ask the teacher to check it before printing.
parallelText.zh: 我们停下来，在打印前请老师检查。

parallelText.en: Meanwhile, the price of paper may go up next month.
parallelText.zh: 与此同时，纸张价格下个月可能会上涨。

parallelText.en: Our teacher shows us a note from the shop about the possible increase.
parallelText.zh: 老师给我们看了商店发来的关于可能涨价的通知。

parallelText.en: We count the cards we need and use both sides of our practice sheets.
parallelText.zh: 我们数好所需卡片，并把练习纸两面都利用起来。

parallelText.en: By planning carefully, we can protect the machine and avoid buying unnecessary paper.
parallelText.zh: 认真计划后，我们既能保护机器，也能避免买不必要的纸。

passages.text: We are getting the school hall ready for a puppet show. The sun is bright at first, so we can see the stage clearly. As it grows later, the sun seems to go down behind the trees. Our teacher switches on the hall lights before the audience arrives. The teacher checks the plugs so the lights will not go out during the show. Then we place the puppets in order and test their voices together. When families enter, the stage is bright and everyone is ready to begin.

parallelText.en: We are getting the school hall ready for a puppet show.
parallelText.zh: 我们正在准备学校大厅，要举办木偶表演。

parallelText.en: The sun is bright at first, so we can see the stage clearly.
parallelText.zh: 起初阳光明亮，我们能清楚看见舞台。

parallelText.en: As it grows later, the sun seems to go down behind the trees.
parallelText.zh: 时间渐晚，太阳仿佛在树后降了下去。

parallelText.en: Our teacher switches on the hall lights before the audience arrives.
parallelText.zh: 观众到来前，老师打开大厅的灯。

parallelText.en: The teacher checks the plugs so the lights will not go out during the show.
parallelText.zh: 老师检查插头，避免演出时灯熄灭。

parallelText.en: Then we place the puppets in order and test their voices together.
parallelText.zh: 然后，我们把木偶按顺序放好，一起试试配音。

parallelText.en: When families enter, the stage is bright and everyone is ready to begin.
parallelText.zh: 家长们进来时，舞台灯光明亮，大家准备开始了。
